sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages twenty-two to twenty-six, of the private snapshot of the Connecticut Driver’s Manual edition dated on its imprint page, the issuer’s own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: second counts, merge openings, passing times and distances, lane counts and sight distances are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none; the cushion, gap, passing, turning, backing and visibility texts on physical pages twenty-two to twenty-six extracted readably, and no page in the range was unreadable.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published driving rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Connecticut Driver’s Manual is one dated edition (Revised March 2023, physical p3); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
